scope: AIC minimum-GPU analytical sizing versus AISimulate aggregated throughput-per-GPU replay search; results are not equivalent.
measurement: Fresh installed CLI process wall time. One case at a time, reversed order on alternating rounds. A pilot primes filesystem caches; measured-variant native release compilation is outside measurements. No CPU affinity or filesystem cache purge.
baseline_derivation: Both AISimulate variants derive from ac96675a6a3b4f9197c19070347c07a5a721cac5 and load the same native binary. Baseline 8714079e disables only the six-line trial padding change in sweeper/sampler.py, restoring that file from 46ca8915a3ba9b5b17c2c925644127a6ed9de869. Controller-only changes on head do not alter measured application code.

publication.transformation: All timing/count/score samples are retained. Local paths, console commands and full reports are omitted. Candidate configurations are keyed by SHA256 of sorted compact JSON; per-sample score maps and before/after comparisons come from full reports. Medians/ranges are computed by variant and algorithm.

prediction_comparison.candidate_matching: Canonical prediction_config, independent of completion order and candidate IDs.

host_load_caveat.note: Observed while second recorded round was running; unrelated user task, not stopped or changed.

prior_observation.description: An unrelated release build for another PR used one CPU core. It was not stopped or changed.

host_load_caveat.limitation: Shared workstation, not a dedicated benchmark host. This snapshot is not continuous host-load monitoring; small before/after differences can reflect scheduling/thermal load as well as changed suggestion trajectories.
